title: Engine F2 — Activation and action-economy ownership
description:
Own provider-neutral deterministic capability operations in engine:F2
for activation and action-economy ownership.

Scope is limited to (a) legacy magic-item executionReadiness backlog entries
assigned to engine:F2, and (b) operations explicitly positively
selected into this family under the accepted ADR-0020 capability contract.
Historical class, spell, creature, hazard, rule, feature, equipment, or other
cross-domain references are candidate/salvage evidence only; they do not enter
this family merely because an earlier audit, clause reclassification, hook,
typed field, or source passage mentioned them.

An operation outside the bounded legacy backlog enters this family only by an
explicit positive capability selection that declares operation, required inputs,
exclusions, identity/revision, residual DM interpretation, real runtime binding,
provider-neutral execution, and deterministic state/resource effects where
applicable. Family completion proves only those named operations/facets. It is
not a claim about the complete mechanics of a record, clause, source family, or
corpus, and it is not a prerequisite for SRD re-freeze merely because legacy
backlog remains unselected.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every engine:F2 capability positively selected and in force has source-faithful inputs, stable capability identity/revision, explicit exclusions and residual DM interpretation, a real runtime binding, provider-neutral execution, and correct deterministic state/resource effects and replay behavior where applicable.
- Legacy executionReadiness entries assigned to engine:F2 but not positively selected may remain backlog; they are not treated as satisfied, absent, safe, or re-freeze blockers merely because they are unselected.
- Membership outside the bounded legacy magic-item backlog requires explicit positive capability selection. Audit findings, typed fields, hook inference, source prose, old clause classification, or domain-bead membership do not automatically create a capability obligation.
- Conformance evidence proves the named operation/facets and declared limits, not whole-record, whole-clause, family-wide source, or corpus completeness.
- Unknown, malformed, or unsupported input to a capability in force fails closed; unbound/unclassified/unknown results never prove absence of mechanics.
- Completion of this family is not required for SRD re-freeze except insofar as a capability actually in force must satisfy its positive contract.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
ADR-0020 post-migration repair 2026-09-10: independent audit of the published
Beads projection found this family parent still carried the pre-ADR automatic
cross-domain membership / every-member-green contract after its children were
narrowed. The operative description and acceptance criteria now make the
family a bounded legacy-backlog and explicit-positive-selection owner. Older
cross-domain examples remain historical/salvage evidence only.
